Holiday bulletin for customers
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travelers with pets should check in early and keep carrier paperwork ready.

Holiday Travel Notes for Pet Flyers

Please read this before you head to the airport. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is handling a steady run of pet bookings, and the main thing to remember is to keep your pet calm, your forms handy, and your plans flexible.

We are checking each trip with safety first, not speed. That means the desk may ask for extra review if a crate looks small, a carrier latch seems loose, or a pet seems uneasy. Please do not pack the carrier at the last minute. Use familiar bedding, clean water, and enough room for the animal to stand and turn. If Hana Davis or Jonah Alvarez are traveling with Blue, or if any other customer has a worried pet, let the desk know right away so a supervisor can take a careful look and help sort out the issue.

If your route changes, if weather adds pressure, or if your pet needs special care, bring the details to us before you get to the gate. The team will keep the process plain and steady, and we will talk through each step in simple terms. We want every traveler to leave with a clear plan and a safe pet beside them.

Please come to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before departure.
